claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: Hearsay requires an out-of-court assertion by a person, not a factual event.
Robert falling asleep is a direct fact, not an assertion offered for truth.
Testimony about an observed event is direct evidence, not hearsay.
If derived from a report, it might qualify as hearsay when offered for truth.
Negligence claims rely on conduct, not out-of-court assertions.
The fact is offered to prove negligence, satisfying the truth requirement.
